phase: After execution freeze, before any training rollout or weight update; baseline evaluation generation still running
reason: Increase throughput for the eight-prompt training rollout batch by allowing eight concurrent vLLM sequences. This changes scheduling capacity only; prompts, seeds, sampling parameters, model, adapter, objective, and evaluation generator stay fixed.

changes.details: Configurable sequence concurrency accepts 2, 4, or 8 and defaults to 8; receipt adds timed generated-token throughput. A genuine memory failure may trigger a separately recorded fallback to 4 then 2.
